records.text: Once-gentle magical servants used to tend Sunstrider Isle’s gardens, the Tenders have become aggressive and uncontrollable. Lanthan Perilon describes their loss of control as a danger to the isle, while mourning that survival leaves the blood elves little choice but to put them down.

Arcane Wraiths haunt Falthrien Academy, where the banished blood elf Felendren uses them as minions. Lanthan Perilon calls them a threat to the Sunspire and asks that they be destroyed along with Felendren. They cast Arcane Bolt in combat and can trigger quest credit when struck by Arcane Torrent.

Magistrix Erona directs the Sunstrider Isle recovery effort after the Scourge invasion disrupted control of the Burning Crystals and their mana wyrm guardians. She treats the crystals’ effects on the isle’s wildlife as part of the crisis, even when recovery means killing corrupted creatures. Erona teaches newcomers through practical tasks, but frames survival as the sin’dorei’s first priority. She sends recruits to her assistant Lanthan Perilon for work concerning Falthrien Academy while she and the Sunspire staff continue containing the crystals.

Julia Sunstriker trains young mages in arcane studies. She offers instruction to those ready to focus and able to meet the training costs, and directs new mages to seek her out for class training. Her available services include mage training and talent-related options.

Jesthenis Sunstriker is a paladin trainer on Sunstrider Isle. He says he once trained young paladins entering the order and has taken up that duty again. He regards guiding a new paladin in the Light as both an honor and a privilege, and approaches it with humility.

Lanthan Perilon helps restore control on Sunstrider Isle. He mourns the once-gentle tenders now grown aggressive, yet asks that they be put down for the island’s survival. He directs efforts against Felendren and the wraiths at Falthrien Academy, warning that Felendren’s fate shows what unchecked magical addiction can do to blood elves. He sees the island’s recovery as urgent and depends on resourceful help.

Summoner Teli'Larien trains young blood elf warlocks in the Sunspire on Sunstrider Isle. His welcome makes clear that lessons carry a price in coin and in mental resolve; he expects students to pay attention, obey instruction, and face dangerous secrets without fear. He warns that he will not tolerate failure.

Matron Arena trains young blood elf priests in the Sunspire on Sunstrider Isle. She describes priesthood as both healing bone and spirit and serving as a fist of vengeance against those who wrong her people, rejecting the assumption that the path is simply pacifist. Training has a cost, and she asks students to learn with an open mind.

Pathstalker Kariel trains rogues in the Sunspire on Sunstrider Isle, but treats the craft as something best kept discreet. He says his instruction costs a cut of the student's take and warns that any caught theft must never be traced back to this conversation. His guarded greetings ask whether a visitor was followed, and he can conjure an elegant letter through a separate gossip exchange.
Shara Sunwing is a general supplies merchant in the Sunspire on Sunstrider Isle. Visitors can browse her goods; her wares include ammunition.
Raelis Dawnstar is a weaponsmith in the Sunspire on Sunstrider Isle. Visitors can browse his goods, and he offers repairs.
Jainthess Thelryn is a cloth and leather merchant in Eversong Woods. Visitors can browse the goods, and Jainthess offers repairs.
Faraden Thelryn is an armorsmith on Sunstrider Isle. He sells goods and repairs equipment.

A Feral Tender is one of Sunstrider Isle’s former garden servants, once used to help tend the gardens. The tenders have grown out of control and become aggressive; this one can cast Renew when wounded.

Well Watcher Solanian keeps vigil over the Sunwell at the Sunspire, even amid the upheaval on Sunstrider Isle. He asks others to recover his scattered belongings so he can maintain his watch, and urges visitors to honor Dath'Remar Sunstrider, the elves’ first king. He believes blood elves must master their hunger for magic to survive.

Arcanist Ithanas studies the malaise afflicting Sunstrider Isle, where the destruction of the Sunwell shattered the magical control that had kept many creatures docile. He is investigating arcane slivers from mana-using beasts as evidence of the island’s troubles and as possible material for a new means of control. His work demands quiet contemplation, and he is reluctant to be drawn away from it.

Arcanist Helion teaches young blood elves to control their thirst for magic, warning that unchecked cravings can turn them into Wretched. He sees discipline and mastery as essential to the survival of his people. In the aftermath of the Sunwell’s destruction, he studies the corruption troubling Sunstrider Isle and regards a tainted arcane sliver as a disturbing possible clue to its source.
A tainted arcane wraith is a hostile magical creature serving Felendren the Banished at Falthrien Academy. It can be struck by Arcane Torrent for a training quest and attacks with Slow.

Outrunner Alarion helps shuttle goods between Sunstrider Isle and Falconwing Square. She welcomes capable newcomers and offers them errands. The route is dangerous: she mourns outrunners killed by the Wretched and says the guards should watch them more closely. Her greeting to a returning visitor is warmly familiar.
A young Springpaw beast, one of many cubs in its local area.

Felendren was banished from blood elf lands after refusing the warnings of teachers and elders about controlling his hunger for magic. Described as one of the Wretched and a threat to the Sunspire, he uses wraiths as minions. His taunt tells enemies that their friends will not mourn their passing for long; he uses Mind Flay in combat.
Sunstrider Guardians are city guards who order passersby to move along and warn citizens not to push their patience. They also answer specific gestures with sharp, dismissive warnings.
A small lynx found in Eversong Woods.

Marniel Amberlight keeps the inn at Fairbreeze Village, where visitors can make it their home and browse her goods. She says Silvermoon has largely given up on the village, but its people refuse to leave because it is home.

Larianna Riverwind watches over the Scorched Grove. She describes burning the border woods to slow the Scourge's advance, a painful choice that brought her people into conflict with treants who had been their allies and are trying to regrow the forest. Old Whitebark was her old friend; his pendant recalls a better time, and she asks that it be buried where they first met.

Lieutenant Dawnrunner is a Farstrider ranger defending the sin'dorei lands around the Farstrider Retreat. She sends aid against Amani raids and warns that the trolls have kept the rangers pinned down while planning an attack on Fairbreeze Village. With allies scarce and trust strained, she also teaches that rangers can turn to the forest and its creatures for aid.

Arathel Sunforge is a blacksmith at the Farstrider Retreat who teaches the profession, repairs gear, and sells wares. Though the Amani and sin'dorei have a history of hostility, he respects Amani weapon-making: he praises Spearcrafter Otembe's hammer for its balance and strength and hopes to use it on unfinished projects.

Ley-Keeper Velania is responsible for keeping the West Sanctum running, and she is plainly frustrated when its energy converter fails and arcane wraiths pour out. She suspects the strain of increasing the sanctum’s load may have caused the malfunction, while treating rumors of night elf sabotage cautiously. Once the wraiths are under control, she hopes the damage is not permanent.

Apprentice Mirveda studies the taint in the East Sanctum’s soil, seeking to learn whether its corruption can be reversed. Her samples lead her to conclude that the change is irreversible, though she considers the results valuable enough to send to a magister for review. When Scourge appear during her research, she senses their presence and calls for a fight; she uses Fireball in combat. Her former mentor has lost faith in the work, but Mirveda refuses to return and insists on pursuing her research.

Aeldon Sunbrand commands the Blood Hawks at Falconwing Square and treats the Wretched as both a danger to themselves and a threat to the city. Stolen unstable crystals could blast the walls, he warns, and he is also concerned that the failure will reflect badly on his men. When evidence identifies Prospector Anvilward as an Ironforge spy, Aeldon orders a quiet killing rather than capture or a public execution, fearing the spy could escape and word could spread. Afterward, he says the Ranger General has been informed and vows the dwarves will pay for their treachery.

Velendris Whitemorn directs the response to the Wretched at Sunsail Anchorage. After they attack and leave most of his side's weapons behind, he asks for the armaments to be recovered so his people can strike back. Once most are retrieved, he calls for a decisive attack on their leader, Aldaron. His praise comes with a dry joke that his men must have softened Aldaron up first, then he urges the player to keep their nose clean and make a name for themselves.

Ley-Keeper Caidanis is the arcanist responsible for maintaining the North Sanctum. He explains that the sanctums draw energy from ley-line currents, providing a steady source after the Sunwell's destruction. His courteous but pointed remark to the visiting dwarf Mr. Anvilward suggests he finds the guest's keen interest in their operations unexpected.

Ven'jashi is a Darkspear prisoner held by the Amani at Tor'Watha. He says Chieftain Zul'Marosh poisoned him and left him to die, and that Zul'Marosh burned his village. Ven'jashi presents revenge as the condition for dying in peace, recounting that he killed many Amani before his capture.

Chieftain Zul'Marosh is an Amani chieftain and the target of Ven'jashi's revenge. Ven'jashi accuses him of poisoning him and burning his village; those claims come from his enemy's account. Zul'Marosh is also identified as being in Zeb'Watha across Lake Elrendar.

Spearcrafter Otembe is an Amani craftsman associated with a reputedly magical hammer prized for its lightness and balance. Arathel Sunforge says he appreciates the quality of Amani weapons despite the long hostility between the Amani and sin'dorei, and hopes to use Otembe's hammer to craft a weapon. This account comes from Arathel, not Otembe.

Old Whitebark is remembered as the treant elder Larianna Riverwind first met at the Scorched Grove; his pendant recalls their old friendship, which Larianna wants laid to rest at the nearby runestone.

Ranger Jaela helps defend the Dead Scar from Scourge advancing toward Silvermoon. Worn down by a long day of fighting, she has little patience for idle chatter, but welcomes help guarding the Scar and urges her men to stop the undead defiling their city.

Velan Brightoak addresses Fairbreeze Village's shortage of ranger gear by turning Springpaw pelts into hand-crafted armor. With the rangers occupied by skirmishes against the Amani, he asks for help gathering pelts.

Magister Jaronis salvages the arcane cores from malfunctioning patrollers, hoping to put their still-useful power to work for the strained sanctums. He is also entrusted with an unmarked letter for Ley-Keeper Caidanis, linking his work at Falconwing Square to the North Sanctum's upkeep.

Prospector Anvilward presents himself as a curious visitor to the North Sanctum, telling Ley-Keeper Caidanis that he appreciates the information about its arcane workings. After inviting an audience, he sets out; his remarks turn wary, and he warns against an ambush. His movement suggests a meeting with a tense, potentially dangerous end.

Innkeeper Delaniel welcomes visitors to the Falconwing Square Inn, where she offers meals and rooms. She can bind a visitor's hearthstone there and replace a lost one, and also sells goods. When Erona's package is delivered, she thanks the courier and invites them to make themselves comfortable.
Marsilla Dawnstar welcomes visitors to Falconwing Square and handles the Collector's Edition gift voucher. She invites the bearer to exchange it for a companion gift and welcomes them to Azeroth.
Aleinia is a Jewelcrafting trainer in Eversong Woods. She invites visitors to learn the intricacies of the trade and offers training.

Ranger Sallina is a Hunter trainer on Sunstrider Isle. She describes the hunter's path as mastery of beasts, precise marksmanship, and survival, and offers training for a fee. She directs new visitors to Well Watcher Solanian, and greets fellow rangers warmly.
An Eversong Tender is a creature found in Eversong Woods.
An Eversong Green Keeper is a creature found in Eversong Woods.

A Withered Green Keeper is one of the treants trying to regrow the forest at the Scorched Grove. Their former allies among the blood elves have turned against them after the woods were burned to halt the Scourge, and the conflict has become violent.

Arcane Patrollers voice the blood elves’ civic ideals: upholding the law, serving the public trust, and protecting the innocent. They call out one of these duties when a fight begins, presenting themselves as defenders of Eversong’s public order.

An Amani Axe Thrower is a troll fighter stationed around Zeb’Watha and Tor’Watha. The Amani raids into blood elf territory have made these settlements a focus of conflict; Lieutenant Dawnrunner describes the Amani as neighbors disputing ownership of the remaining blood elf lands.
An Amani Shadowpriest is a troll spellcaster encountered around Zeb’Watha and Tor’Watha. In combat, this Amani priest attacks with Shadow Word: Pain.
An Amani Berserker is one of the Amani forces encountered in Eversong Woods. When badly wounded, it becomes enraged.
A Wretched Urchin is consumed by pain and hunger, searching for a new source and saying it must feed soon. These cries mark the Urchin as one of the Wretched afflicted by an insistent craving.
A Wretched Thug is consumed by pain and hunger, searching for a new source and saying it must feed soon. These cries mark the Thug as one of the Wretched afflicted by an insistent craving.
A Mana Stalker is an arcane creature found near the West Sanctum, where a damaged energy converter has released arcane wraiths. It attacks with Moonfire.
A Manawraith is one of the arcane creatures pouring from the damaged West Sanctum energy converter. It attacks with Faerie Fire and bursts into arcane residue when it dies.
A feral dragonhawk hatchling of the Eversong Woods, this young beast is encountered among the region’s wildlife. When badly hurt, it may cast a spell.
A crazed dragonhawk roaming the Eversong Woods, this beast attacks intruders and can cast a spell in combat.
A Springpaw stalker, this beast ranges through the Eversong Woods.
An elder Springpaw beast encountered in the Eversong Woods.
A Plaguebone undead among the Scourge in the Dead Scar, this pillager is one of the mindless undead Ranger Jaela calls on others to fight. It attacks in combat.
A Rotlimb cannibal among the Scourge in the Dead Scar, this undead creature is encountered as a hostile presence.
Angershade is an undead creature of the Dead Scar. When badly wounded, it enrages and falls into a frenzy.
Darkwraith is one of the undead roaming the Dead Scar near Fairbreeze Village. When badly wounded, it enrages and falls into a frenzy.
Rotlimb Marauders are undead roaming the Dead Scar near Fairbreeze Village. In combat, a marauder can strike with Disease Touch.
Grimscale Murlocs inhabit the coast around the Dead Scar. When driven to flee, one can use Fear and run for assistance.
Grimscale Foragers range along the coast near the Dead Scar. In combat, a forager can attack with a Bottle of Poison.

Hathvelion Sungaze is a Farstrider ranger at Tranquil Shore, where he sees the Grimscale murlocs as a threat to Quel’Thalas. One killed his companion and now wears the companion’s ring; Hathvelion seeks personal revenge as well as their defeat. He speaks with fierce resolve about driving invaders from the land.

Captain Kelisendra is stranded near Sunsail Anchorage after the Grimscale murlocs took her cargo and navigation rutters, while the Wretched seized her magical goods and her crew abandoned ship. Velendris and his rangers protect her at a nearby camp. She hopes to recover enough cargo to leave and sail again, and ruefully blames herself for ignoring a warning to leave the dock.

Apprentice Loralthalis is a Quel’Thalas apprentice sent back by Magister Duskwither to shut down the Duskwither Spire’s power sources. She finds it overrun by magical creatures and asks for help with the task and with locating the missing groundskeeper, Wyllithen. After learning that some apprentices have fallen to addiction, she plans to remain nearby and retrieve their remains when it is safe.

Mmmrrrggglll is the Grimscale chieftain at the Golden Strand. Hathvelion Sungaze says the chieftain killed his companion and now wears that companion’s ring as a mark of mockery; he seeks revenge and asks for the ring to be recovered. Mmmrrrggglll uses chain lightning and frost shock in combat.

Eversong Rangers are among the defenders Jaela has ready near the Dead Scar, south of the city, as the Scourge attack. A request to bless them with Power Word: Fortitude reflects concern for the guard’s morale; the rangers register that aid for the task. In combat they shoot and may flee to seek help when badly hurt.

Ranger Degolien was sent to investigate a Wretched attack on a nearby shipyard and requested reinforcements. When the player reaches him, the Wretched have taken Sunsail Anchorage; he asks for help driving them back and frames the task as teaching them discipline. He later directs the player toward the Farstrider response to the Amani threat.
Ranger Selron is a named ranger.

Apprentice Ralen was left behind to watch what remained after Wretched raiders took supplies from him and fellow apprentice Meledor, who pursued them. In Antheol's disciplinary episode, Ralen is one of the two students targeted by the rod; when struck, he reacts, “What? Oh, not this again!”

Ranger Sareyn helps defend Fairbreeze Village from Scourge attacks coming through the Dead Scar. She directs the village’s response, urges defenders to hold their positions, and coordinates help against the undead. She suspects a damaged protective runestone may explain the increased attacks and sends a report to Runewarden Deryan at the border. Sareyn treats the danger as ongoing and the village’s defenses as strained.

Apprentice Meledor is Antheol’s student. After Wretched attackers throw Antheol’s elemental grimoire into the river, Meledor asks for help recovering it. Once the damaged book is found, he proposes hiding what happened and asks that Antheol be told it was dropped in a puddle. Antheol later sends a disciplinary rod against Meledor and another student; Meledor protests that there had been a deal. The episode shows his concern about the instructor’s reaction and his willingness to shift blame.
Apprentice Veya is a humanoid in Eversong Woods.

Thaelis the Hungerer is a Wretched ringleader whom Silvermoon's wanted notice blames for repeated crimes against the city's people, including the murder of two guards. The notice calls for his death; it does not record his own account of those events.

Magister Duskwither investigated ways to purify alternative magical sources, but his work corrupted the flows at his school and some pupils became Wretched. After realizing the danger, he evacuated Duskwither Spire, though its power sources remained active. He blames himself for the apprentices lost, fears others will repeat his mistakes, and intends to destroy the journal documenting his research.

A Duskwither apprentice is a pupil of Magister Duskwither's school. The magister closed the school after his investigations into purifying alternative magical sources went wrong, and evacuated the Spire when some pupils had already fallen to corruption.

A mana serpent is one of the magical beasts overrunning Duskwither Grounds after the magister and his apprentices left. Groundskeeper Wyllithen calls the creatures anomalies and asks for help clearing them from the grounds.

An ether fiend is one of the magical beasts overrunning Duskwither Grounds after the magister and his apprentices left. Groundskeeper Wyllithen calls the creatures anomalies and asks for help clearing them from the grounds.
A Darnassian scout at the West Sanctum uses stealth and reveals himself when attacked. He is among the suspicious night elf intruders reported near the sanctum.

Groundskeeper Wyllithen maintains the Duskwither Grounds. When magical creatures overrun the grounds and the Magister and apprentices leave, he complains that they abandoned him without warning and asks for help clearing the creatures so he can resume his work.

Instructor Antheol is a sharp-tongued teacher who tests visitors as readily as his apprentices. He turns a student's crush into a request for help, expects his two students to earn back their apprenticeship after he disciplines them, and uses retrieved pond water and living branches in his magical work. His lecture compares students to sheep: useful and likeable under close guidance, prone to trouble when left alone.
A Silvermoon Apprentice found in Eversong Woods.

Lord Saltheril hosts parties at his country home to celebrate Quel’Thalas, and frets over keeping them supplied with wine, food and fireworks. He is absent-minded: he struggles to remember visitors and can forget having just sent someone for supplies. His requests have drawn an angry response from Magistrix Dawnstrider, who resents the time they take from defending Quel’Thalas; Saltheril calls her rude and considers raising the matter with Silvermoon’s regent lord. He treats the supply dispute lightly and soon turns back to party preparations.

Elisara Sunstriker is a companion of Lord Saltheril, whom she addresses affectionately and calls “Salthy.” She takes a keen interest in the parties they host, their supplies and wine, and who is welcome among their guests. She is bored waiting to join the festivities and imagines a nighttime picnic overlooking the fighting at the border as an exciting outing. She also speculates that Saltheril may rise in rank as sin’dorei nobility has been diminished.
Magistrix Eredania is an enchanting trainer. Her available greeting text is curt, asking visitors what they want or whether they can see she is busy.
Arcanist Sheynathren is an alchemy trainer. The available greeting text is curt, asking visitors what they want or whether they can see they are busy.
Wretched Hooligans have overrun Sunsail Anchorage alongside Wretched Thugs. Ranger Degolien seeks to drive them back while waiting for reinforcements.

Courier Dawnstrider is a secret messenger sent into the Ghostlands with an urgent warning from Regent Lord Theron. Injured and disoriented, he knows he cannot continue and asks a stranger to carry his letter to Arcanist Vandril in Tranquillien. His uncle fears for him and describes him as a nephew who is like a son.

Anathos is a stable master whose services include stabling pets and helping recover lost companions. His greeting offers either kind of help, reflecting the two stable services available through his dialogue.
Vara is a cloth and leather merchant who offers access to her goods. Her local role is defined by trading in those two kinds of wares.

Skymistress Gloaming runs the flight route from outside Shepherd's Gate in Silvermoon to Tranquillien. She offers the ride as a quick way back and can carry Quartermaster Lymel's goods on the return trip. Her greeting is brisk and practical; she calls for guards.

Apothecary Thedra is treating Courier Dawnstrider for the plague. She judges that it is taking hold and urgently asks for blood samples from plagued beasts south of the river, intending to distill a serum. Her manner is direct and confident in her craft; after the potion seems to work, she keeps Dawnstrider close until he regains strength and points the visitor toward him.

Magistrix Landra Dawnstrider is a sin’dorei magistrix in Eversong Woods, carrying the strain of a people displaced by the Scourge. Her nephew, Courier Dawnstrider, was sent on a secret mission into the Ghostlands and never returned; Landra fears for him and says he is like a son to her. She also worries about a former apprentice pursuing dangerous research at the East Sanctum. When the apprentice’s notes suggest the Dead Scar’s damage is irreversible, Landra says she will alert the grand magister and sees this as further reason for the sin’dorei to seek their fate in Outland. She resents Lord Saltheril’s repeated supply requests while Quel’Thalas remains under attack.
Silvermoon Guardians serve throughout the city and its surrounding districts. When asked for help, a guardian offers directions toward city services such as the dragonhawk master and guild master.
Geron is the weapon merchant in the Silvermoon area of Eversong Woods. His role is distinct from the nearby merchants who specialize in armor and shields or general goods.
Farsil is the armor and shield merchant in the Silvermoon area of Eversong Woods, with a specialty distinct from nearby weapon and general-goods merchants.
Sheri is a general-goods merchant in the Silvermoon area of Eversong Woods. Her wares include ammunition, distinguishing her stock from the nearby weapon and armor specialists.
Areyn is a general-goods merchant in the Silvermoon area of Eversong Woods, separate from nearby merchants specializing in weapons, armor, or shields.
Sathiel sells trade supplies.
Landraelanis is a tradesman who sells goods.

Paelarin is a bowyer with fierce hostility toward trolls, questioning the alliance with them and declaring that the only good troll is dead. Paelarin offers supplies for hunting trolls and makes no distinction about which trolls are targeted.

Winaestra breeds and sells hawkstriders, calling them noble creatures and warning buyers to treat them well because an angry hawkstrider is dangerous. Winaestra also challenges some would-be buyers to prove their dedication and attain exalted standing among the blood elves.

Celoenus is a warlock trainer who recognizes a desire for power and treats the craft as secrets for trained ears. Celoenus dismisses those judged unsuitable with a contemptuous accusation of lacking a spine.
Daestra is a humanoid in Eversong Woods.
Garridel trains mages in the arcane. His recorded manner is blunt: he offers help with a student's studies, but rebukes those he judges unable to grasp the subject's intricacies.
Hannovia trains hunters and recognizes a fellow ranger. Her recorded greetings range from guarded dismissal to pleasure at meeting someone sane, giving her a dry, selective welcome.
Telenus teaches hunters how to train and untrain their pets, and limits his help to hunters and their companions. He also directs young hunters onward to instructors in their own regions.
Kanaria teaches First Aid. Her guidance distinguishes basic instruction from further advancement, for which she points learners toward the renowned Doctor Gregory Victor at Hammerfall.
Mathreyn is a skinning trainer.
Noellene trains paladins in the Light and its naaru-related power. Her recorded words judge the path by iron will and unfaltering resolve, and sharply dismiss those she considers lacking them.

Ponaris teaches the priestly arts in the troubled Eversong settlement. He speaks of the Light as a source of strength and calls on its blessings to bolster the rangers facing the Scourge in the Dead Scar, treating spiritual practice as a way to sustain others as well as oneself.

Quarelestra treats cooking as a lifelong pursuit and welcomes fellow enthusiasts. She trains cooks in Eversong and points those seeking mastery toward Dirge Quikcleave in Gadgetzan, recognizing that ambition may lead beyond her own instruction.
Sathein is Eversong's leatherworking trainer. He offers practical instruction and can guide aspiring leatherworkers through the profession's training services.

Tannaria teaches rogue techniques in Eversong and keeps an air of secrecy, asking one visitor whether they were followed. A separate letter errand adds to that guarded impression, though its purpose is unstated.

Perascamin is a riding trainer at Thuron’s Livery in Silvermoon. He offers riding instruction and mount purchases; he says he can teach hawkstrider riding and may require exalted standing with the blood elves.
Aldaron the Reckless is a named combatant.

Runewarden Deryan is stationed by the Ghostlands border, where Scourge attacks threaten Eversong’s remaining protective runestones. He has sworn not to let them fail. Suspecting the renewed attacks signal a malfunction, he directs help to restore the Eastern Runestone’s power and warns that the Scourge will try to destroy it.
Sempstress Ambershine is a tailoring trainer and merchant who offers training and goods. She is brisk with visitors, asking what they want and telling them not to waste her time.
Botanist Tyniarrel teaches herbalism and sells supplies. In conversation, she is curt and impatient, asking visitors not to waste her time and pointing out that she is busy.

Ardeyn Riverwind stands with the people of Fairbreeze Village against the Scourge, speaking of his race’s tenacity and resolve. He sends people seeking work to his sister Larianna, who watches over the Scorched Grove.
Zalene Firstlight sells food and drink at Farstrider Retreat. She says the proceeds help keep the Retreat in good shape, tying her trade to the upkeep of the place.
Halis Dawnstrider is a general-goods merchant in Fairbreeze Village. He offers a broad range of goods for sale and invites customers to browse at their leisure.
Rahein is a blade vendor who also offers repairs. His services make him a practical source of weapons and equipment care.
Eldinarcus is an elemental found in Eversong Woods.
Tregla is a named rare creature.
Jilanne sells dragonhawk hatchlings and delights in how tame they can become when properly raised, contrasting their companionship with their viciousness in the wild.
Silanna remains confident that the Sunwell’s power will soon be restored and believes others are making their situation seem worse than it is.
A Wretched captive begs for mana crystals or shards, saying it must feed soon and that the pain is unbearable.
A novice ranger considers hunting the Wretched after a bounty is announced for one of them.

Sergeant Kan'ren is pursuing Thaelis the Hungerer, a Wretched leader accused of killing two of his guards. He angrily defends harsh treatment of the Wretched and demands that a captive reveal where its leader hides.
Duelist Larenis trains weapon users as a weapon master. He teaches that winning a bout depends on cunning, reflexes, and knowledge of one's weapon as well as strength.

An Eversong partygoer chats about enjoying the party, its springpaw appetizers, and the Suntouched Special. The guest may recognize a visitor and mention restocking supplies, while sharing gossip about Elisara Sunstriker and Lord Saltheril and a rumor of watching the Scourge at the border.
Broom is a critter found in Eversong Woods, Silvermoon City and Crystalsong Forest.

Master Kelerun Bloodmourn is a Blood Knight who conducts the order’s Second Trial. He calls four named champions into the contest, urging them to test the initiate, then recognizes a successful trial as a step toward adept status. His words frame the challenge as a measure of discipline and endurance within the order.
Kinamisa sells leatherworking supplies. Her vendor role is identified directly by her subname, and her menu offers the player a chance to browse her goods.
Sleyin is a weapon vendor who ties her stock to the Wretched threat and the war effort. She claims to have what is needed to deal with the Wretched, but keeps the source of her goods secret.

Kyrenna sells cheese, a trade her mother dedicated herself to. She finds the work tedious, complains about spending the day among the smell of bad feet, and would rather be surrounded by cakes, pastries and bread. She wishes for wine to go with her cheese.

Solanin sells bags while trying to load a wagon; whatever she puts aboard keeps reappearing. She regrets giving her sister Silanna a tome of cantrips and believes Silanna does not see the danger in the woods. Solanin intends to move within the city walls once the wagon is loaded.
Erilia is an enchanting vendor in the local settlement.
Sailor Melinan is a drink vendor in the local settlement.
A Red Hawkstrider, a beast found in Eversong Woods.
A swift pink hawkstrider, identified by its speed and plumage.

Whitebark's Spirit is a sorrowful presence who says violence cannot undo what happened and laments failing his people. He resents having his slumber disturbed. In his quest completion text, he accepts the pendant as a memorial and imagines a new tree growing in the burned forest.
Jero'me, Mo'rrisroe's minion, is eager for company and offers to share his rhymes when someone comes to speak with him.
Jane is a child at play on the beach. She gently tells her father she is beside him and that he has been asleep all day, then resumes playing.

Jessel wakes startled from a dream that ranged across places including Azuremyst, Bloodmyst, Zangarmarsh, Shadowmoon, and Zul'Aman. He calls for Jane, then sounds relieved when he realizes it was a dream.
A purple hawkstrider, identified by its plumage.
A blue hawkstrider. Its name describes its coloring.
A black hawkstrider. Its name describes its coloring.
A swift purple hawkstrider. Its name describes its coloring and speed.
A swift green hawkstrider. Its name describes its coloring and speed.

Nova is a curious, playful child who collects shells and wonders whether one can carry the sound of the sea. She looks toward the Sunwell from the shore, and delights in finding something shiny. Her idle actions show her picking up a shell, holding it to her ear, and shaking dirt from it.
Manny is a non-combat pet in Eversong Woods.
Kitty is a non-combat pet in Eversong Woods.
A golden dragonhawk hatchling in Eversong Woods, one of the young dragonhawks found in the area.
A silver dragonhawk hatchling in Eversong Woods, one of the young dragonhawks found in the area.
A red dragonhawk hatchling in Eversong Woods, one of the young dragonhawks found in the area.
A Blood Elf Reveler found around Eversong’s festival grounds. The reveler’s idle behavior includes choosing among several random emotes, giving this event character a lively presence.
An Eversong Pink Elekk, one of the pink elekks targeted during the beer garden’s parade disturbance. These elekks are seen by people who are drunk or wearing Synthebrew Goggles.

The Eversong Woods Flame Keeper tends the Horde's festival fire in the woods. The keeper welcomes visitors who come to honor it, reminds them that the Horde's fires are spread across its settlements, and urges them to desecrate Alliance fires as unworthy.
A Silvermoon dragonhawk is a high-level beast found in both Eversong Woods and the Ghostlands. In combat, it uses Fire Breath, giving this creature a dangerous edge.

Lieutenant Julek serves the Argent Dawn in Silvermoon during the Scourge invasion. He calls on defenders to investigate the strange glowing runic circles outside the city, whose energy resembles that around the undead and the Necropolis, and to bring proof of their findings and the Scourge slain. Their voices unsettle him, but he considers the threat urgent.
The Golden Crawler is a low-level beast found at several sites in Eversong Woods.

A cheerful Blood Elf spirit in Silvermoon's graveyard, glad to visit friends and family again and share old stories. The spirit admits to having already eaten the family's cooking and asks for more Bread of the Dead.
Alice Rigsdale is a cooking trainer. She welcomes would-be cooks and says she usually gets many new students when Pilgrim's Bounty comes around.
John Rigsdale is a Pilgrim’s Bounty vendor in Outland. Visitors can browse his goods.
Ghostly Blood Elf Celebrants are associated with a reunion of friends and family, celebration, and sharing stories of old. Their conditional greeting expresses pleasure at visiting together again.

place_records.text: You are in Eversong Woods, Horde land in the Eastern Kingdoms. Its main settlements are Sunstrider Isle, Fairbreeze Village and Farstrider Retreat, all held by the Horde. Springpaw stalkers roam the woods, Grimscale murlocs haunt the shore, and Scourge undead press in from the east while Amani trolls raid from the southeast.

You are in Sunstrider Isle, a Horde settlement in Eversong Woods. The Sunspire houses the mage, warlock, priest and rogue trainers, and Magistrix Erona directs the recovery after the Scourge invasion disrupted the Burning Crystals. Since the Sunwell's destruction, its tenders have grown aggressive.

You are in Golden Strand, a stretch of coast in Eversong Woods south of the river inlet. Grimscale murlocs are the main trouble here, and their chieftain Mmmrrrggglll wanders the shore wearing a slain companion's ring.
You are in Sunsail Anchorage, a shipyard on the coast west of Fairbreeze Village. The Wretched have taken it, and Wretched hooligans and thugs hold it under their leader, Aldaron the Reckless.

You are in Fairbreeze Village, a Horde village in Eversong Woods. Silvermoon has largely given up on it, but its people refuse to leave, and Marniel Amberlight keeps its inn. Ranger Sareyn helps hold it against Scourge attacks coming through the Dead Scar to the east, while Wretched raiders press in from the west.

You are in Farstrider Retreat, a Farstrider post in Eversong Woods northeast of Fairbreeze Village. Lieutenant Dawnrunner leads its rangers against Amani raids, and the smith Arathel Sunforge works here. Magister Duskwither, who evacuated the Duskwither Spire, is among its people, and the bowyer Paelarin sells supplies for hunting trolls.

You are in North Sanctum, one of the arcane sanctums of Eversong Woods, which draw steady energy from ley-line currents since the Sunwell's destruction. Ley-Keeper Caidanis maintains it, and the bag seller Solanin sells her wares nearby. Tenders and springpaw stalkers are a danger here.

You are in West Sanctum, an arcane sanctum in Eversong Woods where Ley-Keeper Velania keeps the energy running. A destroyed energy converter lets arcane wraiths and mana stalkers pour out of the sanctum. A Darnassian scout, a night elf, is among the suspicious intruders reported near it.

You are in East Sanctum, an arcane sanctum in Eversong Woods that the Scourge overran on its way to Silvermoon. Its soil is tainted and draws undead, and Apprentice Mirveda concludes the taint cannot be reversed. Rotlimb marauders and angershades roam the site.

You are in Saltheril's Haven, a country home in Eversong Woods where Lord Saltheril hosts parties to celebrate Quel'Thalas. He frets over the wine, food and fireworks, and he is absent-minded about his guests. Trainers of enchanting, alchemy, tailoring and herbalism work here.

You are in Thuron's Livery, a stable in Silvermoon. Winaestra breeds and sells hawkstriders and warns that an angry one is dangerous, and Perascamin teaches hawkstrider riding but may require exalted standing with the blood elves first.

You are in Stillwhisper Pond, a spot in Eversong Woods where Instructor Antheol teaches. The sharp-tongued teacher disciplines his apprentices Ralen and Meledor, and he has visitors diving for an azure phial at the bottom of the pond.
You are in The Living Wood, a wooded area of Eversong Woods. Eversong green keepers, gnarled walking trees infused with primal magic, are common here and hostile to visitors.

You are in The Scorched Grove, a stretch of Eversong Woods that the Horde burned to slow the Scourge. The treants who were once Horde allies are trying to regrow it, and Withered Green Keepers haunt the grove. A crazed dragonhawk roams the area too.

You are in Zeb'Watha, an Amani camp across Lake Elrendar from Tor'Watha. Amani axe throwers, berserkers and shadowpriests fill it, and its chieftain, Zul'Marosh, is found there. A crazed dragonhawk roams the area too.

You are in Tor'Watha, an Amani camp across Lake Elrendar from Zeb'Watha. Amani shadowpriests and berserkers keep it, and a Darkspear troll named Ven'jashi is held in a cage here. He says Chieftain Zul'Marosh poisoned him and burned his village, and he will not die in peace until Zul'Marosh is dead. A crazed dragonhawk roams the area too.

You are in Duskwither Grounds, a Horde-kept stretch of Eversong Woods where strange things have happened in the spire since the magister and his apprentices ran off. Mana serpents and ether fiends overran the grounds afterward, and Groundskeeper Wyllithen complains that they abandoned him without warning.

You are in The Dead Scar, a black swath of soil cutting through Eversong Woods. Ranger Jaela helps defend it against Scourge advancing toward Silvermoon, and Rotlimb marauders, plaguebone pillagers and Darkwraiths are the dangers on the ground. Rahein, a blade vendor, also does repairs.
You are in Skulking Row, a part of Eversong Woods. Wretched urchins and arcane patrollers are its main dangers.

You are in Dawning Lane, a Horde-kept lane in Eversong Woods where outrunners carry goods between Sunstrider Isle and Falconwing Square. Outrunner Alarion helps shuttle those goods, and she mourns the outrunners the Wretched have killed on the way. Wretched urchins make the route dangerous, and Sunstrider Guardians keep passersby moving along.
You are in the Ruins of Silvermoon, where arcane patrollers built to guard the city now attack on sight. Wretched urchins swarm the ruins as well, and Thaelis the Hungerer is among the dangers here.
You are in Feth's Way, a part of Eversong Woods. Wretched urchins and arcane patrollers roam it, and they are the main dangers.

You are in Falconwing Square, a Horde town in Eversong Woods. Captain Aeldon Sunbrand commands the Blood Hawks here and warns that Wretched have raided supplies of unstable mana crystals that could blast the city walls. Its inn, trainers and stables serve travelers.
You are in Tranquil Shore, a shoreline stretch of Eversong Woods. Grimscale foragers are its main danger, and a crazed dragonhawk and Golden Crawlers roam the area.

You are in Goldenbough Pass, a Horde-kept pass in Eversong Woods. Larianna Riverwind watches over the Scorched Grove, and she describes burning the border woods to slow the Scourge, a choice that set her people against treants who had been their allies. A crazed dragonhawk roams the pass too.

You are in Runestone Falithas, in Eversong Woods, Horde land in the Eastern Kingdoms. Runewarden Deryan keeps watch here over the protective runestones along the Ghostlands border, and Scourge attacks on them are ongoing. A crazed dragonhawk roams the woods and attacks intruders.
